browser.api: local HTTP fixture and Playwright route stubs; no production database or external model

observed_behaviors: No automatic retry on load or page reload
One explicit manual retry POST with current checkpoint and CSRF
Duplicate clicks suppressed; uncertain response reuses same idempotency key
Cancellation sends empty body and idempotency key
Unresolved intent disables resend; cancellation retains unknown usage
Stale checkpoint response requires refresh; foreign detail rejected
Late response after leaving task ignored
Explicit pause/resume events refresh task; replayed heartbeat cannot remount recovery panel
Paused status and brief no longer claim ongoing generation

failures_fixed.cause: Earlier running heartbeat replay repeatedly reloaded a paused task
failures_fixed.fix: Refresh only for explicit recovery_required or continuation_resumed events; added regression and reran browser checks

local_test_environment.browser_config_note: Temporary local-only Vite allowlist for junction package fonts; not committed as product configuration

limitations: No new backend or true database execution in this UI package; previous same-interface backend evidence reused.
No public deployment, production adoption or live external-model browser chain.
Integrity problems, conflicting patches and unresolved intent require actual repair; UI does not claim to repair them.
ADR0119 remains proposed; original 15 and sealed histories unchanged.
